verdict.rationale: Interface stability and deprecation policy are fair questions for a CLI and dev-tool platform like mise, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no versioned API and no deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Version pinning in the evidence covers the tools mise installs, or a user pinning MISE_VERSION in CI, not a versioned mise interface with a deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
